note.ja: 12手法のうちLangevinとCSVRの2手法に専用実装。旧1自由度Langevin/BAOABの調和例を保持し、別版の同じOBABO分割で、非縮退2自由度の調和系とquartic係数λ=0.2の2自由度非調和系を比較します。CSVR単独の運動エネルギー核も検査。他の10手法は実装予定です。
note.en: Two of the 12 methods have dedicated implementations: Langevin and CSVR. Preserve the earlier one-degree-of-freedom harmonic Langevin/BAOAB case. A separate edition compares both baths with the same OBABO splitting for a nondegenerate two-degree harmonic system and a two-degree anharmonic system with quartic coefficient lambda=0.2, and checks the standalone CSVR kinetic-energy kernel. The other 10 methods remain planned.

name.ja: 確率的速度リスケーリング（CSVR）

note.ja: 両方式とも厳密な浴O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2)（OBABO）。CSVRは全運動量に同じ係数、Langevinは各成分に独立OU雑音を作用。γ=1/(2τ)で自由浴のK緩和時間をそろえます。以前のBAOAB例は変更せず別の分割として残します。
note.en: Both use exact O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2), or OBABO. CSVR applies one factor to all momenta; Langevin uses independent component-wise OU noise. gamma=1/(2 tau) matches bath-only K relaxation. The earlier BAOAB release is retained as a different splitting.

note.en: Compare global CSVR and local OU with the same OBABO splitting. Draw initial canonical positions by independent Gaussian-envelope rejection and momenta from Maxwell distributions, and evolve a separate heated initial ensemble.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。
note.en: Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 座標の正規化・CDF・Uの平均/分散を1D求積、HのCDFをKの指数分布と2D座標Boltzmann密度の畳込み積分で得ます。求積公差2e−10と2e−12の差を保存し、独立棄却集団でもH分布を検査。q,p,K,Hの相関には複製間の標準誤差を併記し、刻み差と標本誤差を混同しません。
note.en: Obtain coordinate normalizers/CDFs and U moments by 1D quadrature, and the H CDF by convolving exponential K with the 2D positional Boltzmann density. Save the difference between quadrature tolerances 2e−10 and 2e−12; a separate rejection ensemble also checks H. Report independent-replica standard errors for q,p,K,H correlations, keeping step differences distinct from sampling noise.
